description: This file defines SwiftUI views and NSViewRepresentable wrappers for text interactions within a macOS app, specifically for a transcript text view with editing, scrolling, and interaction capabilities.

classes.name: Coordinator
classes.description: Coordinator class used within TranscriptTextView to act as NSTextViewDelegate and handle text editing events.

classes.name: ClickCatcher
classes.description: Custom NSView subclass that detects mouse clicks to trigger tap actions.

classes.name: TranscriptNSTextView
classes.description: Custom NSTextView subclass with handling for specific key events such as Return, Shift+Return, Escape, and Command+Return.

methods.name: makeCoordinator
methods.description: Creates and returns a Coordinator instance for managing NSTextView delegate callbacks.

methods.name: makeNSView
methods.description: Constructs and configures an NSScrollView containing the custom NSTextView, setting properties for appearance and behavior.

methods.name: updateNSView
methods.description: Updates the NSScrollView and its NSTextView with new attributed text when needed.

methods.name: textDidBeginEditing
methods.description: Called when text editing begins in the NSTextView.

methods.name: textDidEndEditing
methods.description: Called when text editing ends in the NSTextView.

methods.name: textDidChange
methods.description: Called when the text content has changed; updates the bound text state.

methods.name: makeNSView
methods.description: Creates a label view with tappable capabilities, displaying attributed text.

methods.name: updateNSView
methods.description: Updates the label view's attributed string and appearance.

methods.name: mouseDown
methods.description: Handles mouse click events to trigger onTap callback.

methods.name: becomeFirstResponder
methods.description: Overrides to notify when the NSTextView becomes active for editing.

methods.name: resignFirstResponder
methods.description: Overrides to notify when the NSTextView resigns active editing state.

methods.name: keyDown
methods.description: Overrides keyDown to handle special keys like Return, Escape, Shift+Return, and Command+Return.
